post.description: Public — no access token required. Creates an SV (student), GV (lecturer) or NV (staff) account.

Public. Authenticates the user by EMAIL or BUSINESS CODE (identifier — the account must be ACTIVE, i.e. its email verified) and returns an access token (body) plus a refresh token — also delivered as an HttpOnly `auth_refresh` cookie when the request comes from a browser. Browser responses OMIT the refresh token from the body; native/mobile responses include it.

Public — no access token required. Exchanges a refresh token for a fresh access + refresh pair. Browser clients send the refresh token via the HttpOnly `auth_refresh` cookie; native clients send it in the body. Browser responses rotate the cookie and omit the token from the body; native responses deliver the new pair in the body.

get.description: Requires an access token. 401 when the token is invalid, expired, or the account no longer exists — the client must re-authenticate.

post.description: Requires an access token. On success returns 204 (no body). 401 when the old password is wrong or the access token is invalid/expired.
Requires an access token. Revokes the current session — the current access token stays valid until it expires, and browser clients also receive an expired `auth_refresh` cookie. Returns 204.

get.description: Raw CASL rules for the frontend (`createMongoAbility(rules)`). An account that is not ACTIVE, or one without synced permissions, returns an empty rules array.
get.summary: Get the current user's CASL rules

post.description: Requires policy `assign:PlatformUserRole`. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means the role was already assigned (idempotent no-op). System roles (`isSystem`) can only be assigned by the system actor.
post.summary: Assign a role to a user (admin)

post.description: Requires policy `revoke:PlatformUserRole`. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means the role was already revoked (idempotent no-op). System roles (`isSystem`) can only be revoked by the system actor.
post.summary: Revoke a role from a user (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `list:PlatformRole` (school admins are denied). Returns all active roles (soft-deleted excluded) with permission stats.

post.description: Requires policy `create:Role`. The role belongs to the caller school (from the server-side shadow). Permissions must be chosen from the closed allowlist; every rule is forced to the own school.
post.summary: Create a school custom role with permissions (school admin)

get.description: Requires policy `list:Role`. Returns the caller school custom roles (soft-deleted excluded). With `includeSystem=true` the read-only system roles are appended — roles of other schools are never returned. Each item carries `permissionCount` / `groupCount`.

parameters.name: includeSystem
parameters.description: Include system roles (read-only) in the listing — defaults to false

get.summary: List the caller school roles (school admin)

get.description: Requires policy `list:Role`. System roles are readable read-only from any school; a custom role of another school is rejected with `CROSS_SCHOOL` (403), never returned. A soft-deleted or unknown role is `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` (404).
get.summary: Get a role with its permission rules (school admin)

delete.description: Requires policy `delete:Role`. System roles are rejected with `CANNOT_MODIFY_SYSTEM_ROLE` (403), a custom role of another school with `CROSS_SCHOOL` (403). A role that still has active members is `ROLE_IN_USE` (409) — revoke them first. An already-deleted role is `ROLE_ALREADY_DELETED` (409).
delete.summary: Soft-delete a school custom role (school admin)

get.description: Requires policy `list:UserRole`. Paginated ACTIVE grants ordered by `assignedAt` desc. A custom role of another school is rejected with `CROSS_SCHOOL` (403); system roles are platform-managed and resolve to an empty page. A soft-deleted or unknown role is `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` (404).
get.summary: List active members of a school custom role (school admin)

get.description: Requires policy `create:Role`. Returns the closed allowlist of `(action, subject)` pairs an admin may grant on a custom school role.
Requires policy `list:Role`. `totalRoles` = own-school custom + read-only system roles; `assignedStaff` = distinct users holding at least one active school grant.

post.description: Requires policy `assign:UserRole`. Actor, target user and role must belong to the same school. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means the role was already assigned (idempotent no-op).
post.summary: Assign a school custom role (school admin)

post.description: Requires policy `revoke:UserRole`. Actor, target user and role must belong to the same school. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means the role was already revoked (idempotent no-op).
post.summary: Revoke a school custom role (school admin)

get.description: Requires policy `list:UserRole`. Returns only grants of the shared school (actor and target must be in the same school) — global legacy rows stay invisible.
get.summary: List a user's school-scoped roles (school admin)

get.description: Owner view — every field is returned (even fields hidden from others). Missing/deleted profile → 404.
get.summary: Get the current user's own profile

patch.description: Omitted fields stay unchanged; `null` clears bio/avatarMediaId/coverMediaId. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means an idempotent no-op.

delete.description: Terminal — no revival; re-deleting is idempotent (`changed=false`). Always 200 with a body.

put.description: Replace-all semantics: a link not sent is deleted. Always 200 with a body.
put.summary: Replace all social links of the current user profile

put.description: Replace-all semantics: a field not sent drops its override. Always 200 with a body.
put.summary: Replace all field-visibility overrides of the current user profile

get.description: Privacy-filtered for the JWT viewer. Fields the viewer cannot see are omitted. Missing/deleted/hidden non-owner → 404.
get.summary: Get a profile by user id (JWT viewer)

get.description: Fast-read card (displayName/avatarMediaId/status). Missing/deleted → 404. A hidden profile still returns a card with status=hidden.
get.summary: Get a profile card by user id (JWT)

post.description: Requires policy `assign:ProfileBadge`. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means the badge is already active (idempotent no-op).
post.summary: Assign a catalog badge to a profile (admin)

post.description: Requires policy `revoke:ProfileBadge`. Always 200 with a body — `changed=false` means the badge is already revoked (idempotent no-op).
post.summary: Revoke a badge from a profile (admin)

get.description: Returns all catalog badges (reference data). Read-only — badges are seeded, no HTTP CRUD in v1.

post.description: Requires policy `manage:School`. 201 with the new school id; code is normalized + format-validated by the domain (trim + uppercase, A-Z0-9 2-10, §12.9).

get.description: Requires policy `manage:School`. Offset pagination (D16); optional `status` filter (§12.16); `pageSize` clamped by the handler (D20).

patch.description: Requires policy `manage:School`. Patch semantics: omitted = unchanged, null = clear (code is immutable in v1). 200 + `{ changed }` — false = idempotent no-op (D17).

get.description: Requires policy `read:School` + same-school instance check (`{ id }` — the `SCHOOL_READ_OWN` condition key). Own school → 200; other school → 403. Unknown id → 404 `ACADEMIC.SCHOOL_NOT_FOUND`.

post.description: Requires policy `manage:School`. Reversible flip to `active` (D12); repeat request → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).
Requires policy `manage:School`. Reversible flip to `inactive` (D12); repeat request → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).
Requires policy `manage:Faculty`. 201 with the new faculty id; (schoolId, code) unique — duplicate → 409 `ACADEMIC.DUPLICATE_CODE`.
post.summary: Create a faculty under a school (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `manage:Faculty`. `schoolId` is REQUIRED (§12.16) — missing/malformed → 400. Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).

patch.description: Requires policy `manage:Faculty`. Patch semantics: omitted = unchanged. 200 + `{ changed }` — false = idempotent no-op (D17).

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Faculty`. One-way (D12) — archived faculties never return to active; pruned from the org tree by default. Repeat request → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).
Requires policy `manage:Major`. 201 with the new major id; (facultyId, code) unique — duplicate → 409 `ACADEMIC.DUPLICATE_CODE`.
post.summary: Create a major under a faculty (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `manage:Major`. `facultyId` is REQUIRED (§12.16) — missing/malformed → 400. Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).

patch.description: Requires policy `manage:Major`. Patch semantics: omitted = unchanged. 200 + `{ changed }` — false = idempotent no-op (D17).

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Major`. One-way (D12); pruned from the org tree by default. Repeat request → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).
Requires policy `manage:Cohort`. 201 with the new cohort id; schoolId is derived from the parent chain (D6); (majorId, code) unique — duplicate → 409 `ACADEMIC.DUPLICATE_CODE`.
post.summary: Open a cohort under a major (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `manage:Cohort`. `majorId` is REQUIRED (§12.16) — missing/malformed → 400. Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Cohort`. One-way (D12), gated by D11: every student must be graduated/dropped_out — else 422 `ACADEMIC.COHORT_NOT_CLOSEABLE` (FOR UPDATE lock, D24). Repeat request → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).

Requires policy `manage:Student`. All-or-nothing in one tx (D7): any failing row rejects the whole batch — 422 `ACADEMIC.VALIDATION` + `metadata.rowErrors[{rowIndex}]` (R6). Batch cap is `config.importBatchMaxRows` (D20). Optional `classId` must be open AND belong to the cohort (D10).
post.summary: Import a student roster into the cohort (admin)

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Student`. One tx: every enrolled/on_leave student moves to `graduated` (D13) with N outboxed `academic.student.status-changed` events (D18). Fully-graduated cohort → 200 + `graduatedCount:0` (D17).
post.summary: Graduate all active students of the cohort (admin)

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Class`. 201 with the new class id; schoolId is derived from the parent cohort (D6); (cohortId, code) unique — duplicate → 409 `ACADEMIC.DUPLICATE_CODE`.
post.summary: Create a class under a cohort (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `manage:Class`. `cohortId` is REQUIRED (§12.16) — missing/malformed → 400. Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Class`. Allowed at any time (D12 — display-only grouping, no D11 gate). Repeat request → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).

patch.description: Requires policy `manage:Student`. D13 transition matrix — illegal transition → 422; same-status repeat → 200 + `changed:false` (D17). Terminal states never transition out.

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Student`. Rows processed INDEPENDENTLY (per-row tx, R3): one failed row never rolls back another; already-linked students are a successful no-op (D8) — retry-safe. 200 + per-row `{ id, ok, userId?, error? }`.
post.summary: Provision/link accounts for a batch of students (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `manage:Student`. All filters optional and combinable (§12.16) — majorId/facultyId resolve through cohort -> major -> faculty (§7.1). Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).
Requires policy `manage:Student`. Unknown id → 404 `ACADEMIC.STUDENT_NOT_FOUND`.

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Teacher`. All-or-nothing in one tx (D7): any failing row rejects the whole batch — 422 `ACADEMIC.VALIDATION` + `metadata.rowErrors[{rowIndex}]` (R6). Batch cap is `config.importBatchMaxRows` (D20).
post.summary: Import a teacher roster into the faculty (admin)

patch.description: Requires policy `manage:Teacher`. D13 transition matrix — illegal transition → 422; `resigned` is terminal; same-status repeat → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).

post.description: Requires policy `manage:Teacher`. Rows processed INDEPENDENTLY (per-row tx, R3); already-linked teachers are a successful no-op (D8) — retry-safe. 200 + per-row `{ id, ok, userId?, error? }`.
post.summary: Provision/link accounts for a batch of teachers (admin)

get.description: Requires policy `manage:Teacher`. `facultyId` is REQUIRED (§12.16) — missing/malformed → 400. Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).
Requires policy `manage:Teacher`. Unknown id → 404 `ACADEMIC.TEACHER_NOT_FOUND`.

Requires policy `read:School` + same-school instance check (`{ id }`). 5-level tree school -> faculties -> majors -> cohorts -> classes (no students/teachers); includeArchived=false prunes archived subtrees; unknown school → 404; other school → 403.

Requires policy `manage:School` (SUPER_ADMIN-only — the target user may belong to any school). Admin/debug route — other BCs must read through the `IAcademicReader` port instead (§6.1). User not linked to any Student/Teacher/SchoolAdmin → 404 (HTTP contract; the port answers null for the same data).

post.description: Requires policy `read:SchoolAdmin` + same-school instance check. 201 + `{ schoolAdminId, userId, linked }` — `linked:false` means the row was created but provisioning failed (retry via link-account, NOT by re-creating). Duplicate `(schoolId, adminCode)` → 409 `ACADEMIC.DUPLICATE_CODE`; unknown/inactive school → 404/422.
post.summary: Create one school admin + provision its Auth account

get.description: Requires policy `read:SchoolAdmin` + same-school instance check. `schoolId` is REQUIRED — missing/malformed → 400. Offset pagination (D16, clamp in handler).

post.description: Requires policy `read:SchoolAdmin` + same-school instance check. Idempotent: already linked → 200 + `linked:false` with the same `userId` (no new provisioning call).
post.summary: Retry account provisioning for one school admin

patch.description: Requires policy `read:SchoolAdmin` + same-school instance check. `inactive` = revoke (Auth login locked + `SCHOOL_ADMIN` role revoked); `active` = reopen (unlock + re-assign). Same-status repeat → 200 + `changed:false` (D17).

get.description: Requires policy `read:SchoolAdmin` + same-school instance check. Unknown id → 404 `ACADEMIC.SCHOOL_ADMIN_NOT_FOUND`.
get.summary: Get one school admin by id

post.description: Requires policy `create:Post`. DRAFT by default; `publishImmediately` creates + publishes in one transaction. 201 + `{ postId }`.

get.description: Public — anonymous callers only see PUBLIC posts; non-PUBLIC rows are filtered (never leaked as 403). Cursor pagination (D6); `limit` clamped by the handler.
get.summary: List posts of one owner (public, cursor-based)

get.description: Public — anonymous callers only see PUBLIC posts. Every denial surfaces as 404 (never 403) so the read path never leaks existence (D7).

patch.description: Requires policy `update:Post`. DRAFT-only — published posts reject with 409. Patch semantics: omitted = unchanged, `null` = clear/detach. 200 + `{ changed }`.

delete.description: Requires policy `delete:Post` (lifecycle of own/operated content; ownership enforced by `ContentActorGuard`). Idempotent — already DELETED → 200 + `changed:false`.

post.description: Requires policy `update:Post`. Non-DRAFT → 409; empty (no content/media/poll) → 422. 200 + `{ changed }`.
Requires policy `hide:Post`. Idempotent on HIDDEN (`changed:false`). Optional `reason` body — send `{}` when there is none.
Requires policy `hide:Post`. Only from HIDDEN, else 409. 200 + `{ changed }`.
Requires policy `pin:Post`. 4th pin per owner → 422 `CONTENT.PIN_LIMIT_REACHED`. Already pinned → 200 + `changed:false`.
Requires policy `vote:Poll` (participation standing; single/multi-choice semantics enforced by the handler). Past `endsAt` → 409. 200 + `{ voteIds, changed }`.

delete.description: Requires policy `vote:Poll`. Idempotent — no votes → 200 with empty `voteIds`.
delete.summary: Retract all my votes in a post poll

post.description: Requires policy `create:Comment` (participation standing). Polymorphic target (`POST`|`EVENT`); `parentCommentId` set = reply (depth capped at 9 keeping the real parent). 201 + `{ commentId, depth, rootCommentId }`.

get.description: Public — visibility of the parent post is enforced (HIDDEN post → 404, never a leak). VISIBLE roots only; `nextCursor` passes through untouched (sparse pages accepted v1).
get.summary: List root comments of one target (public, cursor-based)

get.description: Public — every comment grouped by `rootCommentId`, newest-first. A non-VISIBLE root → 404.

delete.description: Requires policy `delete:Comment`. Author or post moderator (post owner / page operator); EVENT-target comments are author-only. Idempotent — already DELETED → 200 + `changed:false`.

post.description: Requires policy `hide:Comment`. Post owner / page operator only — never the author, never on EVENT targets (handler 403). Optional `reason` body — send `{}` when there is none.
Requires policy `hide:Comment`. Same moderation guard as hide. Only from HIDDEN, else 409.

put.description: Requires policy `react:Reaction` (participation standing). Same `type` as the existing row = toggle-off (`reactionId: null, action: removed`); different `type` = update in place; no row = create.

delete.description: Requires policy `react:Reaction`. Idempotent — no row → 200 with `action: removed` and `reactionId: null`. An incidental `type` query param is ignored (removal is type-blind).

get.description: Public — HIDDEN parents resolve to 404 (never a leak). Optionally narrowed by `type`. Counts only — no display-info batch (the client resolves names/avatars).
get.summary: List reactions of one target (public, cursor-based)

post.description: Rate 20/h per user (21st → 429 `MEDIA.RATE_LIMITED`). Returns the asset id + presigned PUT URL; the client PUTs bytes, then confirms. 201.
post.summary: Presign an image upload (PENDING + R2 PUT URL, 10m)

post.description: Rate 10/h per user (11th → 429 `MEDIA.RATE_LIMITED`). `maxDurationSeconds=90` enforced by Stream + webhook (A2). The client PUTs bytes, then reports via notify-uploaded. 201.
post.summary: Init a video upload (PENDING + Stream Direct Upload URL, 30m)

post.description: Owner-gated like confirm-image (unknown id, SOFT_DELETED, or owner mismatch → 404, never leaks existence). Stream readiness still arrives via webhook/reconcile. 200 + `{ changed }`.
post.summary: Report a finished video PUT (PENDING → PROCESSING)

post.description: Owner-gated. Missing object → FAILED/UPLOAD_EXPIRED; oversize (>10MB) or magic-bytes mismatch → FAILED + R2 object deleted. 200 + `{ changed }` on READY.
post.summary: Confirm an image upload (verify HEAD size + magic bytes → READY)

post.description: Idempotent (D6): every call lands the newest visibility (default PUBLIC, A9) + refreshes `attachedAt`. v1 accepts the end-user JWT; the owning domain verifies ownership beforehand via `IMediaReader.validateOwnership`. 200.
post.summary: Attach an asset to an owning entity (overwrite visibility + refresh attachedAt)

get.description: Owner-gated poll (non-owner → 404, never leaks existence). `RESTRICTED` assets expose metadata with `displayUrl: null` — signed URLs resolve through the internal batch only.
get.summary: Poll one asset (metadata + PUBLIC display URL)

post.description: PUBLIC → static URLs, RESTRICTED → signed + `expiresAt` (image 15m / video 6h, A8). At most 50 ids; unknown/unresolvable ids map to `null` for that entry. 200.
post.summary: Batch-resolve display URLs (1 call per request, no N+1 — spec §6.3)

get.description: Trusted service read — no viewer gate (the API key is the authorization). Unknown id, malformed id, or SOFT_DELETED → 404. `displayUrl` is always `null` (URLs resolve via the batch).
get.summary: Read one asset for an owning domain (existence + owner + status)

delete.description: Called by the OWNING domain (draft-delete, moderation-delete). Idempotent — already SOFT_DELETED → 200 + `changed:false`. Physical removal happens in the purge cron.

post.description: `ready` with duration > 90s → FAILED/VIDEO_TOO_LONG (A2); `ready` without a usable duration → FAILED/ENCODE_ERROR (fail closed, never stuck). Duplicate deliveries apply exactly once. 200.
post.summary: Apply a Stream encode result (ready → READY, errored → FAILED)

get.description: JWT-only. Scores PUBLISHED in-scope posts real-time at query time (D9); cursor pagination (D6); `limit` clamped by the handler.
JWT-only. Followed owners AND still in-scope (F5 — follow never widens visibility); degrades to an empty page while the Social Graph source is undecided (D4).
JWT-only. Verified PAGE posts of the viewer school, reverse-chronological; degrades to an empty page while Community ships no verified source (D4).
JWT-only. `ownerId` required; `ownerType` defaults to `USER`. Cursor pagination (D6); `limit` clamped by the handler; short pages accepted when Content filters ids out (D10).
get.summary: List posts of one owner (pinned-first, cursor-based)

get.description: JWT-only. Returns the locked taxonomy (§2.3) filtered to `reportable` entries for the target type. 200.
get.summary: List reportable categories (optionally filtered by target)

post.description: Rate 10/h + 30/day per reporter → 429. Self-report → 422; duplicate (reporter, target) → 409; invisible/missing target → 404 (no leak). Always 202 + `{ reportId }` — never the outcome (N11).

get.description: JWT-only. `{ status: SUBMITTED|PROCESSED }` — never the moderation result. 200.
get.summary: List my reports (status only, no outcomes — N11)

get.description: JWT-only. Effect HIDDEN/MEDIA_REJECTED/WARNED/SUSPENDED/RESTORED + `reviewable` flag for §4.10 appeals. 200.
Requires policy `MODERATION_REVIEW:Moderation`. `schoolId` scopes the queue (wrong school → 403). Server-side order: severity → reviewRequested → AUTO → distinctReporters → createdAt. 200.
Requires policy `MODERATION_REVIEW:Moderation`. Reports mask `reporterId` for non-ADMIN; restricted cases need `MODERATION_RESTRICTED` (else 404, no leak). 200.
get.summary: Get one case (snapshot null when restricted)

get.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_VIEW_EVIDENCE:Moderation`. Media URLs resolve purpose MODERATION (sees SCREENING/REJECTED); every view logs `EVIDENCE_VIEWED`. 200.

post.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_REVIEW:Moderation`. Conflict-of-interest (subject/reporter) → 403; already claimed → 409. Re-claim by the holder extends the TTL. 200.
Requires policy `MODERATION_REVIEW:Moderation`. Holder or ADMIN only (else 403 `NOT_CLAIM_HOLDER`). 200.
Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. Audited. 200.
Requires policy `MODERATION_RESTRICTED:Moderation`. One-way — cannot be undone. 200.
Requires policy `MODERATION_RESTRICTED:Moderation`. No media snapshot, no external provider call, `notifySubject=false`. 201.
post.summary: Open a restricted case from an external flag (e.g. CSAM tool)

post.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_DECIDE:Moderation` (+ `MODERATION_SUSPEND_USER`/`MODERATION_OVERTURN` for those actions — enforced in-handler). One tx: Decision + Actions + Sanction + outbox + Audit. 200.
post.summary: Rule on a case (kind derived server-side)

post.description: JWT-only, subject-only (handler-enforced). One request per (target, requester); 30-day window. 201.
post.summary: Request human review of an automated impact (§4.10)

post.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_LEGAL:Moderation`. `referenceCode` unique; severity forced 5, queue LEGAL. 201.
Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. Duplicate `(kind, pattern)` → 409. 201.
post.summary: Create a text rule (takes effect on publish)

patch.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. `kind`/`pattern`/`categoryKey` are required (the update path re-validates the shape); `action`/`enforcement`/`surfaces`/`enabled`/`note` left untouched when omitted. 200.
patch.summary: Update a text rule (full shape; takes effect on publish)

post.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. Snapshots enabled rules into `ruleset_version`; `text-policy` pollers pick it up within 60s. 200.

get.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. `schoolId` scopes the listing. 200.

post.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. Terminal APPLIED/CANCELLED → 409. 200.

get.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_ADMIN:Moderation`. Open-by-queue, overdue, severe-open, oldest-open. 200.
get.summary: Queue depth + SLA health for a school

get.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_REVIEW:Moderation`. Sanctions plus UPHELD cases in the last 90 days. 200.
get.summary: Read a user's sanctions + UPHELD cases (90d)

post.description: Requires policy `MODERATION_OVERTURN:Moderation`. Lifted event only when no effect remains. 200.

get.description: Service key auth. `notModified:true` when `sinceVersion` is current — the poller keeps its cache. 200.
get.summary: Poll the published text ruleset (service sync)
